description:
Create a C4 software architecture model for an Internet Banking System based on the specification provided in '~/Desktop/c4_architecture_spec.txt'.

You must create a SINGLE draw.io file at '~/Diagrams/banking_system_c4.drawio' containing TWO separate pages:

PAGE 1: 'System Context'
- Create a Level 1 System Context diagram showing the 'Internet Banking System' and its interactions with the Customer and external systems (Mainframe, E-mail).
- Use the C4 shape library (you may need to enable 'C4' in 'More Shapes').
- Label all relationships with the specific descriptions found in the spec text.

PAGE 2: 'Container'
- Create a new page named 'Container'.
- Create a Level 2 Container diagram zooming into the 'Internet Banking System'.
- Show the internal containers (SPA, Web App, API, Database) and their interactions.
- Show external systems/persons connecting to these containers.

FINAL EXPORT:
- Save the .drawio file.
- Export the entire diagram (all pages) as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/banking_system_c4.pdf'.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- The file must have exactly two pages named 'System Context' and 'Container'.
- You must use C4 notation shapes (Person, Software System, Container, etc.).
- All arrows must have text labels describing the relationship (e.g., 'Uses', 'Sends e-mail to').
- Do not use generic rectangles; use the specific C4 shapes.
